subject: Cool, the stunts look AWESOME!!
author: ZombieTron
body:
And here I was thinking Joy Ride was just a silly little avatar racing game! 🙂 Looks like lots of FUN! When is it out?? And is it really going to be FREE??

I like that there are loads of different game modes, not just racing. Looks kinda like an Avatar baby created after an orgy of Flatout, Pure, Midtown Madness and Paradise!!

subject: yes I-like-it-a-lot
author: SUFFUR
body:
So looking forward to DL'ing Joy Ride, a sort of true paradise of arcade driving.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
